systems.name: Horses
systems.registration: Use the game's regular mount registration flow after obtaining an eligible horse.
notes: Use regular horses as the default travel option until a specialised terrain or combat task justifies another mount.
Horse equipment can be lost visually in rare defect states; recheck equipped tack after loading if appearance changes unexpectedly.

systems.name: Special Mounts
systems.registration: Eligible animals can be registered after gaining their trust.
notes: Ferocious animals can be subdued and fed; some species require unique taming methods.
Feeding an untamable animal does not increase trust.
A registered special mount can be fed while riding by selecting food in the inventory and choosing Feed.
Special-mount saddles are separate equipment and are not part of the default appearance.

systems.name: Baby Wyvern
systems.registration: Can be used as a special mount after the relevant pet/mount conditions are met.
notes: Patch 1.10.00 enabled Baby Wyverns to be used as special mounts.

systems.name: Kuku Bird Chick
systems.registration: Can be used as a special mount after the relevant pet/mount conditions are met.
notes: Patch 1.10.00 enabled the Kuku Bird Chick to be used as a special mount.

systems.name: Blackstar
systems.registration: Unlock and access conditions are intentionally hidden behind the major-spoiler guide gate.
notes: Official patch notes identify Blackstar as a controllable mount with a Breath action.
Patch history includes fixes for Blackstar remaining in place after death, walking into water and Breath-related frame drops.
The guide does not treat any Blackstar armour set as confirmed.
